title: Architecture Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
DESIGNSKETCH is a modern architecture and consulting studio focused on creating functional, sustainable, and visually compelling built environments. The company partners with clients across industries to design and optimize architectural solutions that align with business goals and technical requirements. DESIGNSKETCH emphasizes collaboration, innovation, and the integration of emerging technologies into architectural practice. Team members work closely with stakeholders to deliver high-quality projects from concept through implementation.
  
**Role Description**
The Architecture Consultant role at DESIGNSKETCH is a full-time remote position focused on advising clients on architectural strategies and solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include assessing client requirements, developing architectural concepts and reference models, and creating detailed documentation for solution and enterprise architectures. The Architecture Consultant collaborates with project managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to design integrated systems, ensure alignment with standards and best practices, and support project delivery. The role involves leading architecture reviews, identifying risks and dependencies, and recommending improvements to existing architectures. The Architecture Consultant also participates in planning sessions, provides technical guidance, and contributes to continuous improvement of methodologies and tools.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong background in Architecture and Enterprise Architecture, with the ability to design and document scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions.
* Consulting skills, including stakeholder engagement, requirements gathering, and translating business needs into architectural recommendations.
* Experience with Integration concepts and patterns, including system interoperability, APIs, and data flows across multiple platforms.
* Project Management capabilities to coordinate architecture activities, manage timelines, and collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with architectural frameworks (e.g., TOGAF or similar), modeling tools, and industry best practices.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Proven ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality work on schedule.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: GridBeats APM Growth Leader
description:
**Job Description Summary**
The GridBeats APM (Asset Performance Management) Growth Leader deﬁnes and implements the business development strategy for the Power Transmission, Distribution and Industry business segment, with a speciﬁc focus on digital transformation and predictive maintenance services. You will drive the adoption of our Asset Performance Management (APM) portfolio by analyzing the installed base and market trends to define high-impact commercial campaigns, digital asset monitoring strategies, and strategic partnerships that optimize grid reliability and asset health.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Pillars of the Role**

* Commercial Growth: Develop and scale digital asset monitoring packages and value-based sales campaigns that drive commercial growth and long-term customer digital engagement.
* Strategic Market Development: Conduct deep-dive market studies and forge strategic partnerships to accelerate the GridBeats APM roadmap.
* Operational Excellence: Lead cross-functional alignment between engineering, sales, and digital product teams to ensure APM solutions meet evolving grid requirements and customer pain points.

**Operational Activities**

* Growth Strategy: Deﬁne the growth strategy for each product line using historical performance, installed base analytics, and regional requirements. Propose, structure, and deploy external growth strategies, including partnerships and inorganic growth opportunities, to expand our digital footprint.
* Asset Health & Lifecycle Management:

○ Design and deploy service oﬀerings for high-voltage assets (transformers, breakers, cables, disconnectors) that transition customers from reactive to predictive maintenance.
  
  
○ Leverage APM data (e.g., DGA for transformers, Partial Discharge for cables/ GIS, contact wear for breakers) to build compelling, data-driven value propositions.
  
  

* Campaign Deployment: Steer multi-channel commercial campaigns specifically tailored for digital adoption, measuring success through KPIs like number of opportunities generated and converted into orders. Implement and maintain dashboards and KPIs to measure the success of commercial campaigns and growth initiatives.
* Solution Bundling: Create integrated packages combining hardware, ﬁeld services, and software (GridBeats APM) to provide end-to-end lifecycle support. Collaborate with technical and commercial teams to bundle GridBeats software with hardware renewals and life-extension projects.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Coordinate with Sales, Key Account Managers, Engineering, and Finance to ensure alignment on solutions and commercial governance.
* Innovation & Knowledge Sharing: Foster a culture of technical innovation, promote feedback loops for lessons learned, and support cross-functional skill development.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Act as a primary point of contact for clients, delivering technical brieﬁngs.

**Technical Domain Knowledge**
The successful candidate must possess a deep understanding of the following asset health parameters:
  
  

* HV Asset Health: Ability to interpret Dissolved Gas Analysis (DGA), bushing power factor, and thermal data of transformers. Understanding of mechanical timing, SF6 pressure, and contact wear as key indicators for maintenance intervention for Circuit Breakers. Expertise in partial discharge monitoring and thermal imaging to prevent catastrophic failures and unplanned outages of Cables. Proﬁciency in identifying how external environment, load cycling, and grid transients impact the degradation of electrical infrastructure.
* Digital Ecosystems: Demonstrated experience in software-based asset monitoring, cloud/data lake architectures, OT networking, and complex software licensing models.

**Essential Requirements**

* Professional Background: Demonstrated experience as a Project Manager or

Business Development Leader in the industrial or power sector.
  
  

* Technical Proﬁciency:

○ Familiarity with high-voltage products: circuit breakers, GIS/AIS, power transformers, and cabling.
  
  
○ Solid understanding of IEC standards and industrial asset maintenance best practices.
  
  

* Strategy & Analysis: Proven track record in identifying business opportunities through market analysis and managing cross-functional projects.
* Communication: Proficiency in English
* Operational Tools: Proﬁciency with Salesforce and Microsoft Oﬃce suite.
* Qualification: Formal degree in Electrical Engineering or related technical ﬁeld.
* Preferable to have direct experience with digital APM (Asset Performance Management) platforms or remote monitoring systems.
